author: Komorebi P.
scope: Publication source-file identity, availability and metadata integration; no new mathematical proof audit, Lean execution, or scientific numerical replay.
verification_method: Every selected file was read and its SHA-256 compared with the component receipt; declaration fingerprints, component tree digests, file counts and exact Git identities were checked. Checkout line-ending conversions were restored from Git objects whose SHA-256 matched the original receipt before the file check completed.
source_equivalence_check: No declared source path, source receipt or source-collection declaration differs between the fully hashed source revision and this later metadata/review revision.
scientific_status_policy: All current component assessments and review history are retained, including unassessed status for newly imported work. Source availability does not promote scientific confidence.
